column1: # backlog/suite-poles.tsv - BL-1598: the per-file 7000ms duration budget's
# (BL-378) pole register, in the standing-red register's shape (BL-1428). A
# row names an OPEN ticket that owns bringing its file back under budget: a
# file over budget WITH a row here is reported, not refused; a file over
# budget WITHOUT a row refuses as new-pole; a row whose file now measures
# under 80% of the budget refuses as stale (the row leaves in the same land
# that cut the pole); a row naming a closed or absent ticket refuses as
# unowned. Measured 2026-09-16 (specifier npm test run for BL-791 slice C,
# never a rounded-down value. Slice D tickets take rows over as they are
# minted; drain a row by removing it in the same land that cuts its pole.
